reviews.title: Perfect mic for work
reviews.comment: Best mix ever!!! I used it to record my podcast and it was perfect! I had people asking me what mic I was using because it sounded so good. You can hear background noise and it was so easy to use and install. Now, I use it for my meetings and anytime I have to record training videos.
reviews.author: Sharese

reviews.title: Work well, amazing for the price.
reviews.comment: An amazing mic for the price and sounds very good. If your having issues with not being heard and u have the Logitech app I would disable the blue voice option.
reviews.author: Elijah Sommer

reviews.title: Its fine.
reviews.comment: Works as you would expect, less buttons but small package. Static clasp on the cord is horribly placed so you might accidentally catch it and break the cord tip when adjusting.
reviews.author: Mitchel Duke

reviews.title: Great for my set up but dislike the old micro USB to power it
reviews.comment: This replaced my blue yeti it looks nice sounds great and has some extra feat. Including a app to tweak controls like eq comp.denoise ext. It works well only thing I dislike is it still uses the old micro USB I was under the impression this would have a type c and was disappointed this must of been a older model as I could swear my budie let barrow his that was type c so a year or later I was sure it would be other than that its a good mic.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.title: works well
reviews.comment: works well.  way overkill for a simple office setup
